_comment: Recorded Phase 2.4 chapter inventory + Phase 4.3 allotments for job 23 (the RNE golden chapter), authored from the 47 settled rows' recorded per-concept analyses exactly the way rne_place.json was authored: the recorded texts are the evidence. Every one of the 94 recorded texts names distinct chapter content (the highest token overlap between any two is the shared 'reverse the sequence' phrasing pattern, each about different events), so no near-duplicates collapsed — all 94 ship as distinct LA-items, each allotted to the row that carried it. allot_to names the destination by (topic_id, concept_title); the replay provider resolves that pair against the request's own settled_concepts payload, exactly as the place fixture does. Item ids are the positional mint LA-0001… in settled-row order, misconception before error_analysis within a row.

items.rationale: a distinct concrete process error in working with this chapter's evidence; recorded verbatim from job 23's authored analysis and kept as its own inventory item
